compile_crowdsourcing_results: compile crowdsourcing run results from a Mephisto task and save them as CSV or JSON
setup_args_results_compiler: build an argparse parser with output folder, results format, task name, and database path arguments
get_task_data: retrieve task data for all units in a Mephisto task, filtering out unacceptable units
get_worker_name: look up the global worker name from a Mephisto worker ID using the local database
compile_turn_annotation_results: compile turn annotation results with configurable problem buckets for analyzing crowdsourcing conversations
